g.text: Official vllm bench serve --omni | H800 80 GB | MPS enabled | CFM-only FP16 in all arms

path.style: fill: #edf1f6

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #37475a

g.text: FlashInfer is a measured local prototype; its implementation is not included in PR #9231.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536273

g.text: Performance: mean of 4 runs per point from 2 fresh server starts; shading is min–max, not a confidence interval.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536273

g.text: Each timed run has 64 fixed requests with reference audio. TTFA shows the mean of per-run percentiles; all runs retained.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536273

g.text: Quality: separate 64-request runs at C16. Circles = individual runs; diamonds = means. No quality measurements at other C.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536273

g.text: SIM uses the WavLM proxy and a zoomed axis. The small sample does not establish quality improvement or equivalence.
